description: This Java source file defines the LabelService class, which provides CRUD operations and email-label management functionalities for labels within an email application. It includes methods for listing, creating, updating, deleting labels, and assigning/unassigning labels to emails, as well as listing emails by label.

classes.name: LabelService
classes.description: Service class providing label management and email-label assignment operations within the email application.

methods.name: list
methods.description: Lists labels for a specific owner with pagination.

methods.name: create
methods.description: Creates a new label for the owner if it doesn't already exist.

methods.name: update
methods.description: Updates an existing label if owned by the user, with optional name and color changes.

methods.name: delete
methods.description: Deletes a label and its email associations for the owner.

methods.name: assignLabels
methods.description: Assigns a list of labels to an email, avoiding duplicates.

methods.name: unassignLabels
methods.description: Removes a list of labels from an email.

methods.name: listEmailsByLabel
methods.description: Lists emails associated with a specific label for the owner, with pagination.

methods.name: sanitizeColor
methods.description: Sanitizes and formats color strings for labels.

methods.name: toDto
methods.description: Converts a Label entity to its DTO representation.

methods.name: toListItem
methods.description: Converts an Email entity to its list item DTO, including a preview of the email body.
